name: anti-tangent-mcp
description: Anti-tangent MCP server companions: the anti-tangent-protocol on-demand protocol plugin, the bm-scribe Basic Memory note-writing plugin, and I/O-delegation hooks (anti-tangent-shunt for bulk reads, anti-tangent-guard for completion enforcement).

plugins.name: anti-tangent-protocol
plugins.description: On-demand loader for the anti-tangent-mcp drift-protection protocol. A description-triggered skill that loads only the role-scoped protocol part a task needs, and only when a Goal/Acceptance-criteria task appears — keeping the always-loaded footprint to one line.

plugins.name: bm-scribe
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin that writes Basic Memory notes per v0.7.0 project-knowledge conventions and the BM v0.21.1 three-step permalink-canonicalization pattern.

plugins.name: anti-tangent-shunt
plugins.description: Routes I/O-heavy implementer work to a cheap worker model via PreToolUse hooks. Intercepts oversized Read and Bash calls, delegating them to anti-tangent-mcp's bulk_read tool to keep the implementer's context small and token-efficient.

plugins.name: anti-tangent-guard
plugins.description: Enforces anti-tangent-mcp's validate_completion gate at task close via a PostToolUse hook. Detects when a task is marked completed without running validate_completion and returns a blocking instruction to reopen, validate, and re-close.
